reason: HM Land Registry now publishes two official identifier lookup routes keyed by the same Price Paid transaction identifier: Transaction→INSPIRE_ID for a registered freehold polygon and Transaction→UPRN where a reliable title/address relationship exists. This creates a documented indirect INSPIRE polygon↔UPRN bridge for qualifying published transactions. However the project canonical_parcel_id inventory/polygons and a deterministic canonical_parcel_id↔INSPIRE_ID (or transaction identifier) binding are not exposed in this public window, so no canonical parcel can be accepted or assigned a building type.
